candidates.description: This vector represents abstract noun forms and qualities ending in suffixes like "-ity," "-ness," and "-ance."
This vector represents legal rules, statutes, and legislative policy documents.
This feature vector represents the concepts of biological or organizational growth, evolution, and lifecycle changes.
This vector represents political, economic, and institutional terminology related to European governance and international affairs.
This feature vector represents the concepts of economics, finance, and monetary systems.
This vector represents adverbs and adjectives expressing degree, prominence, or exclusivity.
This feature vector activates on terms denoting causation, contribution, or ecological elements.
This feature represents numerical values, statistics, and relative rankings used for measurement and evaluation.
This feature activates for words related to control, authority, and the act of influencing or regulating behavior.
This vector represents sovereign states, nations, and international geopolitical entities.
